lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of at least five vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits. Each column contains between three and five distinct spots arranged in a recurring vertical-linear configuration.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a grid-like arrangement of anchor nodes across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a highlight on the upper edge and a cast shadow on the lower edge, extending from the post-branchial region towards the caudal area.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 4 to 6 small, high-luminance blobs distributed across its surface, with a higher concentration observed near the leading edge and base.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gills exhibits a dense, disordered cluster of smaller high-luminance spots, contrasting with the organized grid pattern of the lateral flank.
